boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named downtown destinations on corridors immediately beyond San José State University.

cards.entity_name: Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Library
cards.title: King Library
cards.subtitle: East San Fernando Street corridor
cards.notes: Enter from East San Fernando Street and use the public library’s floors, exhibits, or scheduled programs during posted hours.
cards.short_summary: A joint City of San José and SJSU library at Fourth and San Fernando.
cards.evidence_claim: The library is a City of San José–SJSU partnership at 150 E. San Fernando Street.
cards.source_title: King Library | San José Public Library
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours before going; entry policies can differ during extended student study hours.

cards.title: Hammer Theatre Center
cards.subtitle: Paseo de San Antonio corridor
cards.notes: Check the current calendar, then approach the theater from the pedestrian Paseo for a performance or campus arts event.
cards.short_summary: SJSU-managed theater facing the Paseo de San Antonio.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the SJSU-managed Hammer Theatre Center at 101 Paseo de San Antonio Walk.
cards.source_title: Cultural Facilities | City of San José
cards.access_notes: Performance access and ticketing vary by event; consult the theater calendar.

cards.title: San José Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: South Market Street corridor
cards.notes: Visit the galleries or time a First Friday; college students can request the museum’s listed free individual admission.
cards.short_summary: Contemporary-art museum at 110 South Market Street.
cards.evidence_claim: SJMA is at 110 South Market Street and lists free individual admission for college students.
cards.source_title: Visit | San José Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Bring applicable college identification for free student admission and check current gallery hours.

cards.title: Plaza de Cesar Chavez Park
cards.subtitle: South Market Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the paths and open lawn for a daytime pause, and check the city page for park updates before planning an event visit.
cards.short_summary: A 2.3-acre downtown city park on South Market Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Plaza de Cesar Chavez Park at 194 S. Market Street with restrooms and daily park hours.
cards.source_title: Plaza de Cesar Chavez Park | City of San José
cards.access_notes: City-listed hours are 8 a.m. to one half-hour after sunset; check posted updates for temporary impacts.

cards.title: The Tech Interactive
cards.subtitle: South Market Street corridor
cards.notes: Plan a hands-on science-center visit from the Market Street entrance; confirm tickets or program availability before you head over.
cards.short_summary: Science and technology center at 201 South Market Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tech Interactive lists its address as 201 S. Market Street, San José.
cards.access_notes: General admission and special programs may require tickets; verify on the organization’s site.

cards.title: MACLA
cards.subtitle: South First Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop by the gallery during its posted hours and look at the current exhibitions or South First Fridays programming.
cards.short_summary: Latino arts organization with a free gallery at 510 South First Street.
cards.evidence_claim: MACLA lists free gallery admission at 510 South First Street and identifies free South First Fridays performances.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are listed as Wednesday–Sunday, noon–5 p.m.; confirm event details before visiting.

cards.title: California Theatre
cards.subtitle: South First Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the presenting organization’s calendar and use the South First Street frontage as your arrival point for a scheduled performance.
cards.short_summary: Historic downtown performance venue on South First Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s downtown cultural-facilities page identifies the California Theatre as a San José cultural venue.
cards.source_title: Cultural Facilities | City of San José
cards.access_notes: Admission, age guidance, and entry times depend on the scheduled performance.

cards.title: San Pedro Square Market
cards.subtitle: North San Pedro Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the North San Pedro Street frontage and check the market’s own directory to choose a current food vendor or event.
cards.short_summary: Downtown market destination on the San Pedro Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The official downtown map identifies San Pedro Square Market in the San Pedro Square District on North San Pedro Street.
cards.access_notes: Vendor offerings and market programming change; review the market’s current information before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Peralta Adobe and Fallon House Historic Site
cards.title: Peralta Adobe and Fallon House Historic Site
cards.subtitle: North Saint John Street corridor
cards.notes: Find the historic site along North Saint John Street and consult History San José for current tour or visitor information.
cards.short_summary: Historic downtown site centered on the Peralta Adobe.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies the Gonzales/Peralta Adobe, built in 1797, as downtown San José’s oldest building.
cards.source_title: Downtown San José: The Heart of our City | City of San José
cards.access_notes: Tour access may be limited to scheduled public programs; confirm with the site operator.

cards.title: St. James Park
cards.subtitle: North Second Street corridor
cards.notes: Take a daytime loop through the historic park and use the official listing to check whether a public activity is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: Historic downtown park centered on St. James Square.
cards.evidence_claim: St. James Park is a historic downtown park whose centerpiece, St. James Square, is on the National Register of Historic Places.
cards.source_title: St. James Park | Visit San José
cards.access_notes: Use public park areas and check event details directly with organizers when applicable.
